We got a list of templates. Need one that corresponds to SN2 (halide leaving, C-N formed). The list includes many, but we need the one that when applied to the given molecule reproduces the reaction (i.e., retrosynthetic step: break C-N bond? Actually SN2 forward: C-Cl + N nucleophile -> C-N formed, Cl leaves. In retrosynthesis, we break C-N bond to give a halide precursor (alkyl chloride) and nucleophile (e.g., amine). So we need a template that does that.

We have many templates; need to find which one matches our molecule. Use check_smiles_reaction_template_matching for each candidate template_id (but we have template_hash not id). The result includes template_hash and reaction_id. The required output wants template_id (the one used to search the database not the hash). The search returned entries with fields: reaction_id, template_hash, retro_smarts_template, canonical_smarts_template, mapped_rxn, etc. The template_id likely is reaction_id? Or maybe there is separate ID. The description: "template_id (the one used to search the database not the hash)". In search results, each entry has reaction_id (maybe the template ID). Probably template_id = reaction_id. We'll assume that.
